name: AXM Verification Entry Observatory
actions: inventory test-shaped module-local files by relative name
identify conventional selftest and discovery-seam-review filenames
inventory matching package script declarations without executing them
keep name matches separate from executable and passing proof
prepare one exact mapped entry as a bounded unexecuted verification request

notes: A filename or prepared request is inventory evidence only. The request contains no command, arguments, environment values, or fixture. Machine Host, module owners, Evidence Desk, Technical Glasses, and Workshop verification programs retain execution, receipt, readiness, and gate authority.
